subject: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

Team —

I’d like to align on (a) what we’re optimizing for in this lifecycle experiments sprint, and (b) a lightweight weekly update cadence so I can keep the exec staff looped without adding overhead.

My understanding of the sprint goals:
- Primary: lift activation (first successful production-like inference call) within 24h/72h for self-serve/PLG developers
- Secondary: improve early retention (repeat usage in week 1–2; D7/D14)
- Tertiary (signal): conversions to higher-intent milestones (billing added, token usage growth, deployment/route created, teammate invite)

Levers launching in parallel:
1) onboarding email sequences
2) in-console nudges (checklist + contextual banners)
3) retargeting for non-activated signups + lapsed users

Guardrails I care about from an exec standpoint:
- deliverability/unsub spikes
- support volume spikes (or specific onboarding-related issue types)
- any SLO/perf impact from console changes

Weekly update request (Friday by EOD PT):
- 5 bullets max (what shipped, early results, learnings, risks/guardrails, what’s next)
- include a single chart snapshot if you have it (activation within 72h + D7)

Ben — are you ok owning the weekly note (with quick inputs from Tyler/Marissa as needed)? If yes, please confirm target distro for the exec update (I can forward to exec staff or you can send to a short list).

Attaching a draft update template to keep it consistent.

Attachment: Weekly_Sprint_Update_Template_v0.docx

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

Yep, I can own the weekly note.

Proposal:
- We send to you + Camila-only, and you forward to exec staff (keeps distribution clean while we iterate).
- First update this Friday will be mostly “launch status + baselines + any early anomalies” since we’re in Week 0/early Week 1.

On goal definition: we’re aligned. One nuance we’re debating in Product is whether “activation” is first 2xx completion vs first streaming success. I’ll sync w/ Marissa + Henry and we’ll lock the metric this week.

Tyler — can you confirm we’ll have activation within 72h by segment/region ready for Friday?

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing — Redwood Inference

---

From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 11:21 AM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

Confirming: we can get a baseline cut for Friday.

What I can ship by then:
- Signup → api_key_created → first_request_success (2xx) funnel, 24h + 72h
- Basic segment slices: region + SDK (where reliably captured) + “new vs returning”
- Guardrails: unsubscribe rate + complaint rate, plus email volume/suppression counts

What may lag (depending on data quality):
- D7 retention for new cohorts (obviously) and any attribution stitching across ads → console events (we’ll have partial).

Marissa/Sean — if there’s a preferred definition of “SLO impact checks” for exec reporting, send it over. I can include a link to the dashboard + a one-line statement (“no regressions observed vs prior week”).

Tyler
Tyler Benson
Marketing Ops & Attribution — Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 1:07 PM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

Aligned on the framing.

On activation definition: Product is leaning toward primary = first_request_success (2xx completion) because it’s stable across SDKs and doesn’t depend on streaming.

We’ll track streaming as a secondary milestone (first_streaming_success) since it correlates with “production-like” usage.

For SLO/perf impact: Sean and I will provide a weekly “console performance is flat” statement + any flagged incidents related to the feature-flagged nudge components.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console — Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:44 AM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

One ask on exec visibility: when we summarize early results, let’s avoid “benchmarks improved” / “X% cheaper” type claims unless we’re linking to a specific published proof point.

For the weekly update, I’d suggest a consistent phrasing like:
- “Messaging highlights (what we tested)”
- “Observed behavior changes (activation/retention metrics)”
- “Any inbound confusion / objections (from Support/Sales)”

I’m happy to review the first weekly note quickly before it goes to Camila.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Product Marketing — Redwood Inference

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 10:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

For SLO impact checks:
- Console p95 page load (Dashboard + Project Setup)
- Error rate on nudge-related endpoints/components
- Any spike in “support link clicked from banner” as a proxy for confusion

We’ll roll up as:
- “No notable regressions week-over-week” or
- “Regression detected; mitigation/rollback executed”

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Reliability & Guardrails — Redwood Inference

---

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 21, 2025 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — goals + weekly exec update cadence

Thanks all — this is exactly the level of structure I wanted.

Decision/plan:
- Activation (primary): first_request_success (2xx completion)
- Secondary milestones: first_streaming_success, dashboard_viewed, billing_added
- Ben owns weekly note, sent to me by Friday 3pm PT; I’ll forward to exec staff.
- Include: (1) what shipped, (2) key metrics snapshot, (3) learnings, (4) guardrails status, (5) next week’s changes
- Soojin to do a quick pre-send check on wording/claims for the first two notes

Ben — for this week, it’s OK if the chart is just baseline + “launch status” since it’s early.

Also attaching a one-pager I used with ELT this morning so we’re consistent on framing.

Attachment: Lifecycle_Growth_Sprint_OnePager_v2.pdf

Camila
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference
